name: Surveys
description: Surveys capabilities. Includes Archive a single survey response., Duplicate a survey to multiple projects in a single transaction, Get aggregated response statistics across all surveys, Get list of archived response UUIDs for HogQL filtering, Get response counts for all surveys, Get survey response statistics for a specific survey, Launch a survey by setting `start_date` to the current time, List survey responses for a specific survey, with question text resolved server-side so callers do not have to map opaque `$survey_response_ ` keys, and 14 more.
